newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Kruszwica sets IPO min price at PLN 25.
newsitem.headline: Polish Kruszwica sets IPO min price at PLN 25.

text.p: Polish edible fats maker Zaklady Tluszczowe Kruszwica SA (Kruszwica) set the minimum price of its December initial public offering at 25 zlotys, the company said in an abbreviated version of its issue prospectus.
Kruszwica plans a main market listing.

At the public offering of 1.65 million shares from December 9 to December 20 investors will be able to register for five to 10,000 shares. The shares will be allotted at the Warsaw bourse on December 23.
The firm's 4.95 million existing shares, all belonging to the state treasury, have also been approved for public trade.
The treasury ministry has said it is seeking a strategic investor for 2.97 million already existing registered shares.
Kruszwica said in the prospectus it plans to net 10.4 million zlotys this year and 12.6 million next year on sales of 484.5 million zlotys and 562.8 million zlotys respectively.
The firm made a net profit of 15.8 million zlotys on sales of 543.2 million zlotys from January 1 to December 20 of last year, when the firm officially became a joint-stock company.
From December 21 last year to September 30, 1996, it netted profits of seven million zlotys on sales of 351.7 million zlotys.
